title: New wire/spawn play+mute paths (audio_flush, toggle_mute) have zero test coverage; the claimed mitigation covers draws only
evidence: audio.odin:306 '    for k in 0..<a.pending.wire_plays {' / :309 '        rl.PlaySound(a.wire[v])' / :313 '        rl.PlaySound(a.spawn[v])' / :326-329 '        for s in a.crisis { rl.StopSound(s) }' '        for s in a.arrival { rl.StopSound(s) }' '        for s in a.wire { rl.StopSound(s) }' '        for s in a.spawn { rl.StopSound(s) }' — repo-wide grep for toggle_mute|audio_flush|kind_volume in *_test.odin returns no matches (exit=1). audio_test.odin:6-8 claims the half is "covered by the harness's consumer mirror (the vacuous guards)", but harness/run.odin:520 asserts only 'if audio_consumer.wire_draws < 1 {' (draws, never plays/mute).
detail: The flush play loops and mute-stop loops for the two new families are behavior changes with NO coverage; the PR's stated mitigation (vacuous guards) exercises the pure consumer half only, not PlaySound/StopSound. P2 gap.
recommended_fix: Extract the cycled-variant index math into a pure helper and pin it; add a device-off flush test asserting pending clears on mute; keep manual device verification documented for the rl calls.

README contract: '- **Wire confirms:** ≤ 120 ms, a low-mid "tock" (falling sweep) — distinct'. Only test_synth_wav_forms touches .Wire (header + non-silence); test_spawn_chime_envelope_and_pitch exists for .Spawn with 'dur_s >= 0.2 && dur_s <= 0.4' — no wire counterpart.
